status: Not recording. No endpoint is configured. The five event names are proposals; the brief does not define them (FLG-R10, Q-07).
privacy_rules: No cookies and no local storage identifiers.
No IP address, user agent or account identifier is sent by the site code.
Only the event name, the page path and a timestamp are sent, and only when an endpoint is configured.
Nothing is sent when the endpoint is empty.

events.name: product_view
events.fires_when: A product card or product page is shown.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires_when: A reader clicks a product link. This mirrors the Associates definition of a qualifying click-through of a Special Link.

events.name: feed_click
events.fires_when: A reader clicks the RSS feed link.
